name: Tolnanémedi (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Tolnanémedi (a crowned blue and green shield with a church and a wavy stripe, with green and yellow mantling) above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tolnanémedi arms with crown, mantling and scroll
